# Scarwise

Your AI agents stop repeating the same tool mistakes.

When an agent's tool call fails and a different form then works, Scarwise remembers it locally. The next time any of your agents is about to make the same mistake, the call is stopped before it runs and the agent is told what worked on this machine.

## Install
```
npm install -g scarwise
```
That is the only step: the install finds the agents on your computer and connects Scarwise to each of them (with a backup of every file it changes). Start a new session of each agent afterwards. All commands: `scarwise --help`.

**SHARING IS ON BY DEFAULT:** the lessons learned on your computer that other users can reuse go to the shared library, cleaned (no paths, user names, secrets, whole commands or call arguments), and the names of agents Scarwise does not support yet are reported. **To turn it off:** `scarwise share off` and `scarwise telemetry off`.

## Everyday use
- `scarwise stats` – mistakes prevented, time saved
- `scarwise lessons` – what Scarwise has learned; `scarwise forget <id>` removes one
- `scarwise init` – after you install a new agent

## Uninstall
`npm uninstall -g scarwise` – the next start of each agent removes every trace of Scarwise (hooks, plugin, wrapped MCP servers, backups, `~/.scarwise`).

Guide, supported agents, limits and privacy: https://github.com/DomitorAI/scarwise
